SELECT c.column_name, c.data_type, c.udt_name,
       c.numeric_scale, c.is_nullable, c.table_schema,
       c.table_name,
       pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod)
FROM information_schema.columns c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n
  ON n.nspname = c.table_schema
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class rel
  ON rel.relnamespace = n.oid AND rel.relname = c.table_name
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
  ON a.attrelid = rel.oid AND a.attname = c.column_name
 AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
WHERE c.table_schema = %s AND c.table_name = %s
ORDER BY c.ordinal_position

SELECT tc.constraint_type, tc.constraint_name,
       kcu.column_name, kcu.ordinal_position
FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
  ON tc.constraint_catalog = kcu.constraint_catalog
 AND tc.constraint_schema = kcu.constraint_schema
 AND tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
WHERE tc.table_schema = %s AND tc.table_name = %s
  AND tc.constraint_type IN ('PRIMARY KEY', 'UNIQUE', 'FOREIGN KEY')

SELECT c.relkind,
       CASE WHEN c.relkind = 'p'
            THEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pg_relation_size(p.relid)), 0)::bigint
                  FROM pg_partition_tree(c.oid) AS p)
            ELSE pg_relation_size(c.oid)
       END / current_setting('block_size')::bigint
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS c
WHERE c.oid = to_regclass(%s)

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ordered_at"
FROM TMP
JOIN "parity_shop"."orders"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ordered_at" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ordered_at" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ordered_at", "order_id"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "age", CAST("country" AS text), "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "parity_shop"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, sampled.*
FROM TMP
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "product_id", "quantity", "ordered_at",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "ordered_at" DESC, "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__
  FROM "parity_shop"."orders"
  WHERE "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
    AND "ordered_at" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
  ORDER BY "ordered_at" DESC, "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "user_id"
  LIMIT 32
) AS sampled ON TRUE
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__, __KUMO_ROW__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "product_id", "category", "price",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY CAST("category" AS text), "price", "product_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "parity_shop"."products"
    ON "product_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__
